keyPoints.en: Distance is total path length (scalar); displacement is the straight-line distance in a stated direction (vector).
keyPoints.bm: Jarak ialah jumlah panjang lintasan (skalar); sesaran ialah jarak garis lurus dalam arah tertentu (vektor).

keyPoints.en: Speed = distance ÷ time; velocity = displacement ÷ time.
keyPoints.bm: Laju = jarak ÷ masa; halaju = sesaran ÷ masa.

keyPoints.en: Acceleration a = (v − u) ÷ t. Negative acceleration is deceleration.
keyPoints.bm: Pecutan a = (v − u) ÷ t. Pecutan negatif ialah nyahpecutan.

keyPoints.en: For uniform acceleration use: v = u + at, s = ½(u + v)t, s = ut + ½at², v² = u² + 2as.
keyPoints.bm: Untuk pecutan seragam guna: v = u + at, s = ½(u + v)t, s = ut + ½at², v² = u² + 2as.

keyPoints.en: Ticker tape: dots close together = slow; dots spreading out = accelerating.
keyPoints.bm: Pita detik: titik rapat = perlahan; titik semakin jauh = memecut.

question.en: A bus starts from rest and reaches 12 m s⁻¹ in 6 s. Find its acceleration.
question.bm: Sebuah bas bermula dari pegun dan mencapai 12 m s⁻¹ dalam 6 s. Cari pecutannya.

tip.en: Always list u, v, a, s, t first and pick the equation without the quantity you don't need.
tip.bm: Senaraikan u, v, a, s, t dahulu dan pilih persamaan tanpa kuantiti yang tidak diperlukan.

keyPoints.en: Displacement–time graph: gradient = velocity. Horizontal line = at rest.
keyPoints.bm: Graf sesaran–masa: kecerunan = halaju. Garis mengufuk = pegun.

keyPoints.en: Velocity–time graph: gradient = acceleration; area under graph = displacement.
keyPoints.bm: Graf halaju–masa: kecerunan = pecutan; luas di bawah graf = sesaran.

keyPoints.en: Acceleration–time graph: area under graph = change in velocity.
keyPoints.bm: Graf pecutan–masa: luas di bawah graf = perubahan halaju.

keyPoints.en: A straight sloping v–t line means uniform acceleration; a curve means changing acceleration.
keyPoints.bm: Garis condong lurus pada graf v–t bermakna pecutan seragam; lengkung bermakna pecutan berubah.

question.en: A v–t graph rises from 0 to 10 m s⁻¹ in 5 s. Find the acceleration and displacement.
question.bm: Graf v–t naik dari 0 ke 10 m s⁻¹ dalam 5 s. Cari pecutan dan sesaran.

tip.en: Split odd-shaped areas into triangles and rectangles.
tip.bm: Bahagikan luas yang pelik kepada segi tiga dan segi empat tepat.

keyPoints.en: Free fall: motion under gravity only, with no air resistance.
keyPoints.bm: Jatuh bebas: gerakan di bawah graviti sahaja, tanpa rintangan udara.

keyPoints.en: All objects in free fall have the same acceleration g ≈ 9.81 m s⁻², whatever their mass.
keyPoints.bm: Semua objek jatuh bebas mempunyai pecutan sama g ≈ 9.81 m s⁻², tanpa mengira jisim.

keyPoints.en: Use the equations of motion with a = g (downwards) or a = −g (upwards).
keyPoints.bm: Guna persamaan gerakan dengan a = g (ke bawah) atau a = −g (ke atas).

keyPoints.en: In air, light objects like feathers fall slowly because air resistance is large compared with their weight.
keyPoints.bm: Di udara, objek ringan seperti bulu jatuh perlahan kerana rintangan udara besar berbanding beratnya.

question.en: A coin is dropped from a 20 m building. How long does it take to land? (g = 9.81 m s⁻²)
question.bm: Syiling dijatuhkan dari bangunan 20 m. Berapa lama untuk sampai ke tanah? (g = 9.81 m s⁻²)

tip.en: At the top of a vertical throw, velocity is 0 but acceleration is still g.
tip.bm: Di titik tertinggi lontaran menegak, halaju ialah 0 tetapi pecutan masih g.

keyPoints.en: Inertia is the tendency of an object to stay at rest or keep moving at constant velocity.
keyPoints.bm: Inersia ialah kecenderungan objek untuk kekal pegun atau terus bergerak dengan halaju malar.

keyPoints.en: Newton's first law: an object stays at rest or moves uniformly unless a resultant force acts on it.
keyPoints.bm: Hukum Newton pertama: objek kekal pegun atau bergerak seragam kecuali daya paduan bertindak ke atasnya.

keyPoints.en: Larger mass → larger inertia → harder to start, stop or turn.
keyPoints.bm: Jisim lebih besar → inersia lebih besar → lebih sukar untuk mula, berhenti atau membelok.

keyPoints.en: Safety: seat belts and headrests protect you from the effects of inertia in sudden stops.
keyPoints.bm: Keselamatan: tali pinggang keledar dan penyandar kepala melindungi daripada kesan inersia semasa berhenti mengejut.

question.en: Why do lorry tankers have many separate compartments?
question.bm: Mengapa lori tangki mempunyai banyak petak berasingan?

answer.en: To reduce the effect of the liquid's inertia sloshing forward when braking.
answer.bm: Untuk mengurangkan kesan inersia cecair yang terhumban ke hadapan semasa membrek.

tip.en: Inertia depends only on mass — not on speed.
tip.bm: Inersia bergantung pada jisim sahaja — bukan pada laju.

keyPoints.en: Momentum p = mv, unit kg m s⁻¹, a vector.
keyPoints.bm: Momentum p = mv, unit kg m s⁻¹, satu vektor.

keyPoints.en: Principle of conservation of momentum: total momentum before = total momentum after (no external force).
keyPoints.bm: Prinsip keabadian momentum: jumlah momentum sebelum = jumlah momentum selepas (tiada daya luar).

keyPoints.en: Elastic collision: objects bounce apart. Inelastic: they stick together.
keyPoints.bm: Perlanggaran kenyal: objek melantun berpisah. Tidak kenyal: objek melekat bersama.

keyPoints.en: Explosion: total momentum is zero before, so pieces move in opposite directions (e.g. rifle recoil, rocket).
keyPoints.bm: Letupan: jumlah momentum sifar sebelum, jadi kepingan bergerak berlawanan arah (cth. sentakan senapang, roket).

question.en: A 0.05 kg bullet leaves a 4 kg rifle at 400 m s⁻¹. Find the recoil velocity of the rifle.
question.bm: Peluru 0.05 kg meninggalkan senapang 4 kg pada 400 m s⁻¹. Cari halaju sentakan senapang.

tip.en: Choose one direction as positive and give the other direction a minus sign.
tip.bm: Pilih satu arah sebagai positif dan beri tanda negatif kepada arah yang lain.

keyPoints.en: Newton's second law: F = ma — resultant force is proportional to rate of change of momentum.
keyPoints.bm: Hukum Newton kedua: F = ma — daya paduan berkadar dengan kadar perubahan momentum.

keyPoints.en: 1 N is the force that gives a 1 kg mass an acceleration of 1 m s⁻².
keyPoints.bm: 1 N ialah daya yang memberikan pecutan 1 m s⁻² kepada jisim 1 kg.

keyPoints.en: Resultant force = applied force − friction (when they act in opposite directions).
keyPoints.bm: Daya paduan = daya dikenakan − geseran (apabila bertindak berlawanan arah).

keyPoints.en: Same force on a bigger mass gives a smaller acceleration.
keyPoints.bm: Daya sama ke atas jisim lebih besar memberikan pecutan lebih kecil.

question.en: A 20 N force pulls a 4 kg box against 8 N of friction. Find the acceleration.
question.bm: Daya 20 N menarik kotak 4 kg melawan geseran 8 N. Cari pecutan.

tip.en: Draw a free-body diagram before using F = ma.
tip.bm: Lukis gambar rajah jasad bebas sebelum guna F = ma.

keyPoints.en: Impulse = Ft = mv − mu (change in momentum), unit N s.
keyPoints.bm: Impuls = Ft = mv − mu (perubahan momentum), unit N s.

keyPoints.en: Impulsive force F = (mv − mu) ÷ t acts for a very short time.
keyPoints.bm: Daya impuls F = (mv − mu) ÷ t bertindak dalam masa yang sangat singkat.

keyPoints.en: Longer impact time → smaller impulsive force (airbags, crumple zones, bending knees).
keyPoints.bm: Masa hentaman lebih panjang → daya impuls lebih kecil (beg udara, zon remuk, membengkokkan lutut).

keyPoints.en: Shorter impact time → bigger force (hammer on nail, karate chop, pestle and mortar).
keyPoints.bm: Masa hentaman lebih singkat → daya lebih besar (tukul pada paku, pukulan karate, lesung dan alu).

question.en: A 0.5 kg ball moving at 10 m s⁻¹ is stopped in 0.02 s. Find the impulsive force.
question.bm: Bola 0.5 kg bergerak 10 m s⁻¹ dihentikan dalam 0.02 s. Cari daya impuls.

tip.en: If the ball bounces back, the change in velocity is bigger (e.g. +10 to −8 is a change of 18).
tip.bm: Jika bola melantun balik, perubahan halaju lebih besar (cth. +10 ke −8 ialah perubahan 18).

keyPoints.en: Weight is the gravitational force on an object: W = mg, unit N.
keyPoints.bm: Berat ialah daya graviti ke atas objek: W = mg, unit N.

keyPoints.en: g = gravitational field strength ≈ 9.81 N kg⁻¹ on Earth's surface.
keyPoints.bm: g = kekuatan medan graviti ≈ 9.81 N kg⁻¹ di permukaan Bumi.

keyPoints.en: Mass (kg) is constant everywhere; weight changes with g (Moon g ≈ 1.6 N kg⁻¹).
keyPoints.bm: Jisim (kg) malar di mana-mana; berat berubah mengikut g (g Bulan ≈ 1.6 N kg⁻¹).

keyPoints.en: Weight is a vector acting vertically downwards towards the centre of the Earth.
keyPoints.bm: Berat ialah vektor yang bertindak menegak ke bawah ke arah pusat Bumi.

question.en: An astronaut has mass 70 kg. Find the weight on the Moon (g = 1.6 N kg⁻¹).
question.bm: Seorang angkasawan berjisim 70 kg. Cari beratnya di Bulan (g = 1.6 N kg⁻¹).

tip.en: Never give weight in kg — it is a force, measured in newtons.
tip.bm: Jangan beri berat dalam kg — ia daya, diukur dalam newton.
